summary: Conviction upheld for rape (Sections 376D, 376A, 376(2)(i) IPC), murder (Section 302 IPC), house-trespass (Section 450 IPC) and POCSO offences; reliance on consistent dying declarations, corroboration by witnesses including defense witness, medical officer endorsement; DNA evidence indicating third person insufficient to discredit prosecution; case not 'rarest of rare'; commutation of death penalty to 20 years rigorous imprisonment without remission considering age (22 years), socio-economic background, loss of mother and brother at young age, prison conduct, and reform potential; balance of mitigating and aggravating circumstances reviewed.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.302 read with s.34
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; conviction sustained; death penalty commuted to 20 years rigorous imprisonment without remission.
